title: Time left above dropped items
description: Sneak near dropped items to see how long each has left; the last seconds turn red.

title: Look at an item
description: Looking at a dropped item shows its time left above it.

title: Death loot timer
description: After you die, a timer in the corner counts down until your items vanish, with an arrow, the distance and the coordinates.

title: /despawnindicator
description: The command tells a server owner how many online players have the mod and when items despawn there.
